title: vTv Therapeutics Announces New Appointments to its Scientific Advisory Board
author: Vtv Therapeutics Inc.
description: vTv Therapeutics appointed a Scientific Advisory Board of distinguished clinicians and scientists to provide strategic guidance on cadisegliatin, a potential oral treatment for type 1 diabetes currently in Phase 3 clinical trials.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company is advancing innovative drug development with a promising new treatment for type 1 diabetes, expanding its Scientific Advisory Board with renowned experts, and progressing Phase 3 clinical trials

title: vTv Therapeutics Announces USPTO Allowance of Patent Covering Cadisegliatin
author: Vtv Therapeutics Inc.
description: vTv Therapeutics received a USPTO patent for crystalline forms of cadisegliatin, a potential oral treatment for Type 1 diabetes, with patent protection extending through 2041.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company secured a patent strengthening intellectual property protection for its lead drug candidate, demonstrating innovation and potential future commercial value

title: vTv Therapeutics Appoints Michael Tung, M.D., MBA, to Chief Financial Officer as Company Reinitiates Phase 3 Trial of Oral T1D Adjunctive Therapy to Insulin
author: N/A
description: vTv Therapeutics has appointed Michael Tung as its new Chief Financial Officer. The company has also reinitiated screening in its CATT1 Phase 3 trial for cadisegliatin, a potential first-in-class oral adjunctive therapy to insulin for the treatment of type 1 diabetes.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The article announces the appointment of a new CFO and the reinitiation of a Phase 3 trial for the company's lead drug candidate, indicating progress and potential for the company.

title: 7MM Type 1 Diabetes Market Drug Forecast and Market Analysis 2023-2024 & 2033: Value to Reach $9.91 Billion - Synergistic Rise of Pumps, CGMs, and Ultra-rapid-acting Insulins in T1D Management

Key drivers include the increased use of rapid-acting insulins, insulin pumps, and immunomodulatory therapies, as well as the rising global prevalence of T1D. However, high prices, patent expiries, and the failure of disease-modifying therapies in clinical trials pose challenges to market growth.
